definition.snapshot: bridge_snapshot serializes the attached table bytes and last_bridge_text
definition.restore: bridge_restore rebuilds the table with the caller's authority policy and restores the text; the 20 describe sentences must still yield 20/20 pairs
definition.policy: a snapshot restored under verifier:v2 rejects a v1 correction and accepts v2
definition.empty: a snapshot with no table restores to sc_bridge=None and last_bridge_text=None
definition.corrupt: truncated, wrong-schema, bad-base64 and text-without-bridge snapshots are rejected whole
definition.closed_state: the nine legacy closed-state readings stay equal before and after

criteria.round_trip: restored table digest and text equal; 20/20 pairs exact
criteria.policy: v1 correction rejected and content digest unchanged; v2 correction accepted and content digest changes
criteria.empty: empty snapshot restores both fields to None
criteria.corrupt: 4/4 rejected with ValueError; no partial table
criteria.closed_state: the nine legacy readings stay equal before and after
criteria.rerun: the R31 anchor carries a commit, a runner blob sha1, a runner sha256 and a core sha256
